t: The net is only for the download.

b.x: GPS works without a signal. A map does not. Download the whole region at home, on Wi-Fi. The best survival app is the one you tested before you left.
CAUTION
The phone is a backup tool. It does not replace a physical compass, a paper map, a lighter, a legal field tool, or a first-aid kit.
HOW TO ACTUALLY USE THEM
How to actually use them
✓ Download maps, guides and forecast at home, on Wi-Fi
✓ Download the whole region — not just the trail
✓ Battery saver / airplane; GPS only when needed
✓ Charged power bank — a solar panel if it fits
✓ Native SOS and medical ID set before you leave
✓ Compass, paper map and lighter in the physical kit
APP FAMILIES
A — THE FIRST
Maps and navigation
Download the whole region, not just the trail. Without this, the rest is talk.
Maps.me Simple offline. Region on Wi-Fi.
OsmAnd OpenStreetMap. Fine control. Heavy.
Wikiloc Real trails in Brazil. Download the track.
Gaia GPS Layers and clip. Test at home.
Avenza Maps Georeferenced PDF. A chart in the hand, digital.
B — THE KNOW-HOW
Offline survival manuals
Water, fire, shelter, knots, plants, aid, signals. Open with no net.
SAS Survival Guide Classic manual. English. Offline.
Gridless Field with no net. Test the cards.
OSG: Offline Survival Guide Compact guide. No cloud.
PrepApp Aimed at a Brazilian public. Download at home.
C — THE CALL
Bearing and emergency
Compass in the pocket first. The app is the second north. SOS before the signal goes.
Bússola nativa iPhone and Android. Calibrate off metal.
SOS nativo Emergency SOS on the device. Medical ID.
what3words Three words. One place. Download the pack.
Lanterna / Morse / apito do sistema What the device already has. A drill.
D — THE GROUND
Weather, water and ID
Forecast downloads at home. A plant app only suggests. A wrong ID can kill.
Windy Wind and rain. Capture the region first.
AccuWeather Forecast. Limited offline. Download.
droply Water points / map. Confirm on the ground.
PlantNet / Seek / iNaturalist A suggestion. Never truth. Do not eat.
A plant app is not a botanist. In doubt, do not eat. Do not put it on skin.
E — THE HAND
Knots and hand skills
Rehearse the knot at home. In the dark, the finger already knows.
Knots 3D Knot on three axes. Offline. Drill.
Useful Knots A short list. The ones the house uses.
MINIMUM DIGITAL KIT
BRAZILIAN BUSH
Brazilian bush
Amazonia, Cerrado, the range and the coast. Signal dies fast. Rain and damp eat the battery.
Prioritise offline maps of the region — not a clip of the trail.
Wikiloc and PrepApp are especially useful in Brazil.
A dry bag for the phone. Damp gets in. The screen dies.
Power bank in the middle of the pack, dry. A short cable. One spare.
A compass you can trust

Reliable is not the app an ad called the best. It is the one that works in airplane mode, asks for no account, shows no ad, and agrees with a street you already know. The hand compass stays in front. The phone is the spare.
IPHONE COMPASS It is already on the device. Do not download another. Open it, do the figure-eight, and test it on a street you know before you leave.
FIELD, ON THIS SITE It reads the magnet from here. No account and no ad. Calibrate with the figure-eight and the north you marked. On Android, it is the clean choice.

ORGANIC MAPS OR OSMAND They serve if the region's map was already downloaded at home. The needle comes with it. Do not install the first free compass in the store: those ask for your contacts and they lie.
Build the digital kit before you leave
Three now: one offline map, one manual, SOS / what3words. Test in the yard. Then the field.
NOTE
Apps help. They do not replace training, physical gear or sense. Confirm local camping rules and the ground. GPS is not a compass. A digital map is not a paper chart.
